welcome.title: Welcome to File Manager
welcome.subtitle: Select a connection to start browsing files
welcome.footerHint: Use keyboard shortcuts for quick actions

explorer.title: Explorer
explorer.actionsHint: Common actions for the current connection are shown here. Delete confirmation is handled here instead of a popup dialog.
explorer.deleteHint: Deleting {name} only removes the saved connection definition. Remote files are not deleted.

search.title: Search
search.placeholder: Enter a keyword and the backend will search selected connections concurrently with incremental results.
search.scopePlaceholder: Select connection scope, or leave empty for all enabled connections
search.emptyResult: No matches were found, or the current search has completed.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.placeholder: No transfer tasks yet. Download tasks will appear here first, then uploads and cross-connection transfers.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.placeholder: No notifications yet. Search errors, connection errors, and transfer failures will be collected here with follow-up actions.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: This page edits the main app config directly. Theme, locale, search, and transfer settings are applied to the current runtime after save.
settings.loadFailed: The current config is not ready yet. Please try again shortly.
settings.generalDesc: Manage UI locale, theme, and the app-level temp directory.
settings.searchDesc: These values affect new backend search requests.
settings.transferDesc: Downloads, uploads, and cross-connection transfers reuse this temp directory setting.
settings.transferDownloadDirPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep using temp; when set and existing, downloads prefer this directory
settings.logDesc: Logging is reinitialized immediately after save.
settings.logOutputsPlaceholder:
One output target per line, for example:
stdout
logs/app.log
settings.pathsDesc: These paths are shown as read-only for now, to avoid partially switching config repositories during runtime.
settings.noteDesc: This slice only exposes application settings that can be updated safely at runtime. Fields like repository paths remain read-only for now.

connection.subtitle: This phase shows connection context and capabilities first; the real file panel comes next.
connection.nextStepDesc: This tab will evolve into the real file panel with directory listing, grid/list view, context menu and drag-drop.

fileBrowser.dropQueued: {count} drag-drop transfer task(s) have been queued for {name}
fileBrowser.dropPrepared: {count} item(s) have been prepared for drag-drop transfer
fileBrowser.dropQueuedSummary: Queued drag-drop transfer for {entryCount} item(s) to {target} ({taskCount} task(s))
fileBrowser.dropQueuedSummarySkipped: Queued drag-drop transfer for {entryCount} item(s) to {target} ({taskCount} task(s)); skipped {skipped}
fileBrowser.dropPreparedSummarySkipped: Prepared drag-drop for {entryCount} item(s) to {target}; skipped {skipped}
fileBrowser.dropNoop: No draggable items could be processed
fileBrowser.downloadPrepared: {name} has been prepared in the temp directory
fileBrowser.uploadQueued: {count} upload task(s) have been queued for {name}
fileBrowser.crossTransferQueued: {count} cross-connection transfer task(s) have been queued for {name}
fileBrowser.newFolderPrompt: Enter a name for the new folder

connectionForm.createSubtitle: Choose a driver and fill its parameters. The form is already grouped by driver type for future extensibility.
connectionForm.editSubtitle: Update a saved connection definition. The driver type stays fixed for now to avoid migration complexity.
connectionForm.testSuccess: Connection test succeeded. Driver {driver} exposes {count} capability entries
connectionForm.testResultSuccess: The current parameters passed the driver connectivity check.
connectionForm.testResultFailed: The current parameters failed validation or connectivity check.
connectionForm.validationFailed: Please fix the required fields and parameter errors first.
connectionForm.validationSftpAuthRequired: SFTP requires a password, private key path, or private key text.
connectionForm.name: Connection Name
connectionForm.namePlaceholder: For example: Prod S3 / Local Workspace
connectionForm.descriptionPlaceholder: Use this field for environment notes or operational context.
